A '''Barrckli''' was present on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. While at the [[Continuum Void]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], the [[Barrckli]] was in a drunken state and had to be dodged by [[Moranda Savich]], a professional con artist who was being pursued by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent [[Hal Horn]]<ref name="IAD">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="IADdate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Interlude at Darkknell]]" to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Barrckli first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s Part I of the short story "[[Interlude at Darkknell]]," included in the [[1999]] ''[[Tales from the New Republic]]'' anthology.<ref name="IAD" />
